text:
Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
The 
relay type PH 54/160T under voltage relay 54-160V, provided to circuits as an 
under voltage protection relay in russian`s protection system the over-current 
protection with under voltage blocking to ensure that the fault is over-current 
where any over-current attended with under voltage the PH 54/160T relay provided 
to this system.
The first draft initialed & tested by eng. Tarik Mohamed Ahmed at 
Maghagha SS, accepted 
by general director eng. 
 Aemad Makalaa,
 and approved by eng. Yahya Mohamed Mahmoud head sector.
Safety Precautions
Work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
 suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 isrequired.
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, safety shoes, 
 helmet breathing mask, safety glasses
Line isolation is required
Make sure VT secondary circuits are opened before testing the relay
Make sure relay contacts are isolated from circuits

Tools and Equipment
Secondary injection tester
Voltmeter, test leads
Work to be Carried Out
Make sure vt secondary 
circuits are opened and isolated from the relay
Isolate relay coil from 
the voltage circuits
Look at field 
maintenance file and compare the position of the setting on the relay with those 
shown on the setting sheet
Make sure relay contact 
was untied before testing
Relay Test
Switch of the dc mcd
Untie terminals to 
 relay contacts from terminal blocks and connect them to stop contact sockets 
 of the tester
Untie terminals to 
 relay coil from terminal blocks and connect them to voltage sockets of the 
 tester
Clean the relay 
 contact and inspect tying
Switch on the tester 
 and show if the stop contact led of the tester light indicate that the relay 
 contact is closed
Increse voltage to 
 open the relay contact and record Vr reset value, so decrease voltage to close 
 contact and record Vop operation value
Record results in this 
 table.
